title: Homelab / Overview
description: Start here. Health now, SLOs and error budgets, backup freshness, one or two key figures per area, and links to every dashboard.

list.name: Argo CD recovery sync (auto-rollback or fix)
list.textFormat: {{name}}: a successful sync after a failure in the previous hour

panels.title: Nodes Ready
panels.description: Ready nodes / all nodes (kube_node_status_condition).

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: warning and critical alerts firing now, Watchdog excluded. Details in Alertmanager.

panels.title: Argo CD apps not Synced/Healthy
panels.description: argocd_app_info. Details: CI-CD dashboard.

panels.title: Public probes down
panels.description: probe_success == 0 of the public hostnames (blackbox-public).

panels.title: Stale backups
panels.description: Backup CronJobs without a success for 26 h, plus Postgres clusters without a base backup for 26 h.

panels.title: NAS pool used
panels.description: nas:pool_used:ratio of the data pool. Details: Storage dashboard.

panels.title: Critical CVEs (fixable)
panels.description: Critical vulnerabilities with a fixed version in running images, one count per distinct image (trivy-operator, ignoreUnfixed). What to fix first: Security dashboard, Act now.

targets.expr: sum(max by (image_registry, image_repository, image_tag) (trivy_image_vulnerabilities{severity="Critical"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: AWS month-end estimate
panels.description: aws_cost_month_forecast_usd. Details: AWS dashboard.

panels.title: Availability, 30 days
panels.description: slo:availability:ratio_rate30d. Red below the 99.5% objective.

panels.title: Error budget left, 30 days
panels.description: slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio_rate30d. 100% = untouched, 0% = spent.

panels.title: SLI data, of 30 days
panels.description: slo:sli_coverage:ratio_rate30d: the share of the 30-day window that has probe results. Below 100% the availability and budget figures cover only that share, so one outage weighs more.

panels.title: Probes now
panels.description: probe_success of every public hostname: UP or DOWN.

panels.title: Burn rate, 1h window
panels.description: Error ratio over 1h divided by the 0.5% budget. 1 = burning exactly the budget; 14.4 pages (with the 5m window).

panels.title: Postgres: hours since the last base backup
panels.description: Barman Cloud plugin, per cluster. Red after 26 h (CNPGBaseBackupTooOld).

panels.title: Backup CronJobs: hours since last success
panels.description: time() - kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time for every CronJob with 'backup' in its name. Red after 26 hours (nightly schedules).

panels.title: Nodes: CPU busy
panels.description: Per node, 5 min average. Details: Nodes dashboard.

panels.title: Nodes: memory used
panels.description: Per node. Details: Nodes dashboard.

panels.title: Gateway 5xx share
panels.description: Envoy downstream 5xx / all, 5 min. Details: Network dashboard.

panels.title: Network drops/s
panels.description: Hubble drops, all reasons. Details: Network dashboard.

panels.title: NAS full in
panels.description: nas:pool_days_until_full at the 7-day trend. Details: Storage dashboard.

panels.title: LAN static devices down
panels.description: blackbox-lan ICMP. Details: LAN dashboard.

panels.title: CI on main
panels.description: Latest run of each workflow on main. Details: CI-CD dashboard.

panels.title: Open pull requests
panels.description: github_pull_requests_open. Details: CI-CD dashboard.

panels.title: New LAN MACs, 7 days
panels.description: MACs first seen in the last 7 days. Details: LAN dashboard.

targets.expr: count(max by (mac) (max_over_time(lan:device_present:max_by_mac[7d])) unless on (mac) max_over_time(lan:device_present:max_by_mac[23d] offset 7d)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Soonest certificate expiry
panels.description: Days left on the public certificate that expires first. Details: Security dashboard.

panels.title: Immich assets
panels.description: Photos and videos. Details: Usage dashboard.

panels.title: Jellyfin streams now
panels.description: Details: Usage dashboard.

panels.title: Nodes Ready
panels.description: kube_node_status_condition Ready=true.

panels.title: Internal endpoints
panels.description: blackbox-internal: API VIP, Gateway, NAS iSCSI/NFS, Keycloak, Argo CD, router DNS, CoreDNS.

panels.title: Pods not Ready
panels.description: Running pods whose Ready condition is false, and restarts in the last 24h.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"}) == 1) > 0

panels.title: Restarts, last 24h
panels.description: Containers restarted in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Certificate expiry (as served)
panels.description: probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry of each public hostname, in days. cert-manager renews at 30 days left.

panels.title: App versions (running image tags)
panels.description: kube_pod_container_info: one row per distinct image.
